pages.title: Basic Crafting Platform
pages.text: The Crafter is the mod's basic crafting device — similar to a crafting table but specialized for the mod's machines.$(br2)Power: None$(br)No power required — the most important early-game device.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Right-click to open the Crafter GUI. Select the item to craft on the left; required materials appear on the right. Insert materials and click to craft.$(br2)Originally integrated into the Protocol Core, the Crafter was split into its own device for better game flow.
